title: OPP-004: Preserve known landing and uncertainty in terminal send wording
description:
## Context

Source: OPP-004, opportunity-evaluator recommendation dated 2026-10-18 (Build). Findings: /Users/0xb1ob/Workspace/picp/opportunities.md:101. Inspected source revision: 73793a89b899cfa38eaf8f2ad8672263f98b41aa. Recheck affected behavior at execution time; repository evidence establishes behavior, not user frequency or measured benefit. Preserve the full opportunity record and its attributed prior recommendations.

Terminal undeliverable messaging can say a request was not delivered even when landing is known and no reply followed, or when retained history cannot establish landing. The specific cause and earlier landing evidence survive; actual duplicate-work incidence is unknown.

## Scope

Correct terminal wording only, using established evidence and retaining the specific cause. Keep the separate evidence-navigation investigation independent. Do not change receipt/API reached-stage semantics, persistence, automatic recovery, or fresh-request retry behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Known landing without a reply is described as received/landed with missing reply, not definite non-delivery.
- [ ] Unprovable landing or absent landed_at remains unknown; absence of a timestamp is not treated as proof of non-delivery.
- [ ] Definite non-delivery is claimed only when existing evidence actually supports it; specific failure causes remain visible.
- [ ] The implementation does not parse error prose into new semantic states or change receipt/API meanings.
- [ ] Deliberate Send again/fresh-ID semantics and bounded internal reconciliation remain unchanged.

## Validation

Cover stop-after-landing, 24-hour landed/no-reply expiry, truncated/unprovable transcript, and evidence-backed non-delivery in focused parent-outbox/parent-delivery tests. Run npm run typecheck and relevant npm run test:one -- tests/parent-outbox.test.ts / tests/parent-delivery.test.ts. Keep any human message comparison proposed until separately executed.

## Execution boundary

No live failures, recovery actions, user outreach, or external publication are part of this backlog-creation request. Do not widen this task into the deferred or duplicate variants in opportunities.md.

## Steps to Reproduce

## Actual Behavior

## Expected Behavior

The relay preserves the furthest established fact and uncertainty without overclaiming absent effects.

title: OPP-005: Validate bounded historical-result discovery

Existing answer history, report links, ledger filters and quick search preserve substantial information. The unverified burden is finding a relevant older result when the maintainer remembers its problem rather than ID, while correctly judging freshness.

## Scope

Compare current retrieval routes with a bounded list using existing question/title/project/date fields and exact source links. Preserve distinct job/answer/report identities. Do not build semantic indexing, automatic lessons, a new memory store, or automatic reuse authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Document available supported fields/queries and missing provenance, including optional answer job IDs and newest-per-job-set report grouping.
- [ ] Fixtures include similar names across projects, incompatible or conflicting results, changed revisions, and a missing evidence source.
- [ ] Measure correct candidate selection and recognition of what must be rechecked, not speed alone.
- [ ] Keep unknown revision/access/immutability explicit and do not merge records based on similar prose.
- [ ] Recommend whether a simple list is sufficient, current routes already suffice, or a narrowly justified next investigation is needed.

## Validation

Use synthetic history and a static field-based list before integrations. Proposed success is easier correct retrieval while rejecting stale applicability; faster but conflated results fail. No live memory writes or repository-wide transcript indexing.

title: OPP-004: Validate exact-target evidence navigation for uncertain sends
description:
## Context

Source: OPP-004, opportunity-evaluator recommendation dated 2026-10-18 (Investigate). Findings: /Users/0xb1ob/Workspace/picp/opportunities.md:101. Preserve the full opportunity record and its attributed prior recommendations.

The current pending message asks the user to inspect the transcript. Original per-send target identity is server-local and not exposed on the pending-send API; current session identity may refer to a different session. A correct session link can still land outside the retained evidence window.

## Scope

Assess a protected exact-target evidence link against the existing UI and corrected/neutral wording baseline. Separate the navigation benefit from copy accuracy. Investigate required target projection and missing-history behavior without building a new public API, UI, historical index, or replay mechanism.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Identify the reliable mapping from pending-send ID to its original recorded session handle; never substitute the current session blindly.
- [ ] Account for protected reads, unknown/missing sessions, absent stable message anchors and bounded transcript history.
- [ ] Mock cases include known receipt, definite non-delivery, unavailable/truncated evidence and a changed current session.
- [ ] Compare correct next-action selection and manual search burden against the existing/neutral-wording baseline; no match remains inconclusive.
- [ ] Deliver a bounded feasibility and value recommendation, with any later implementation scope explicit and no automatic replay.

## Validation

Use synthetic fixtures/mock navigation first. This investigation can use a manually corrected wording baseline, so it has no blocking dependency on the independent copy fix. Success is fewer searches with no unsupported conclusions or unintended fresh request; no gain or misleading links is a failure signal.

title: OPP-006: Validate evidence-sensitive interrupted-action continuation
description:
## Context

Source: OPP-006, opportunity-evaluator recommendation dated 2026-10-18 (Investigate). Findings: /Users/0xb1ob/Workspace/picp/opportunities.md:131. Preserve the full opportunity record and its attributed prior recommendations.

Revival can return interrupted-tool detail and correctly warn that a missing result does not prove failure. Bounded recovery discards that detail before the first continuation; the helper’s optional text says to retry. Static mismatch is verified, but resumed-model behavior is unobserved.

## Scope

Prepare and compare synthetic continuation packets using the existing brief and a concise evidence-sensitive alternative. Distinguish known complete, incomplete, and externally unresolved effects. Investigate the smallest internal handoff; do not implement it or run live recovery as part of this research.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Document the current information flow, best-effort extraction limits and existing recovery gates at the then-current revision.
- [ ] Comparison fixtures include completed, incomplete and unresolved external effects, plus absent/unusable tool detail.
- [ ] Record justified next actions, unsupported retries, preserved unknowns and unnecessary investigation; do not treat confidence alone as success.
- [ ] Separate supported observations from hypotheses, and recommend build/defer/drop for a bounded follow-up with decision-changing evidence.
- [ ] Do not blindly activate the existing retry wording, expose arbitrary sensitive tool arguments, or infer an external idempotency guarantee from tool_call_id.

## Validation

Proposed validation is an offline packet walkthrough or controlled evaluation without tools capable of side effects. Report whether recipients skip completed work, retry only with evidence, and preserve uncertainty on unseen cases. Obtain necessary access/authority before any model trial or participant outreach; otherwise deliver the reviewable study material and identify the remaining evidence gap.

title: OPP-001: Clarify context-preserving setup continuation after login
description:
## Context

Source: OPP-001, opportunity-evaluator recommendation dated 2026-10-18 (Build). Findings: /Users/0xb1ob/Workspace/picp/opportunities.md:56. Inspected source revision: 73793a89b899cfa38eaf8f2ad8672263f98b41aa. Recheck affected behavior at execution time; repository evidence establishes behavior, not user frequency or measured benefit. Preserve the full opportunity record and its attributed prior recommendations.

When model discovery is empty/unreadable, the installer tells the user to log in then rerun cp-install. Ordinary reruns preserve an unpinned choice; README supplies --force and explains broader effects. Intentional unpinned choices and service-environment visibility are legitimate distinct cases.

## Scope

Improve existing post-login continuation output using the current install home/app and flag semantics. Explain what remains unchecked and the broader effects of the proposed command. Do not add a pending-setup state machine, handle credentials, or infer that every unpinned installation is broken.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The emitted continuation accurately reopens model choice where required and preserves custom --home/--app context.
- [ ] --force effects, including dependency reinstall and replacement of differing generated files where applicable, are accurately disclosed.
- [ ] Intentional unpinned choices and protected existing configuration remain supported.
- [ ] Login is not claimed to guarantee a model visible to the service; unchecked/unreadable states stay explicit.
- [ ] Relevant output and README guidance agree without widening installation behavior.

## Validation

Use existing mocked installer/model fixtures to cover no models, ordinary rerun, force, custom home/app and intentional unpinned choices. Run npm run typecheck and npm run test:one -- tests/service-install.test.ts. No real provider login or reinstall is required for this task’s regression checks.

## Evidence

An optional fictional authority rehearsal may help a newcomer predict autonomy and escalation before real delegation. Demand is unobserved. Minimal intake, authority docs, deterministic drills and route preview already exist; preview is not a full mission simulation.

## Scope

Keep product work deferred until newcomer walkthroughs reveal recurring prediction errors under current short docs, or onboarding becomes the explicit priority. Then compare current docs with a skippable three-stop storyboard. Do not build a simulator or stage the exercise with real jobs/mandates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Before activation, document recurring misconceptions under existing docs or explicit onboarding priority.
- [ ] Fictional scenarios include an in-scope continuation, an authority boundary and interrupted/partly completed work, with contract-linked explanations.
- [ ] Assess transfer to unseen cases and recognition of uncertainty, rather than memorized answers or subjective confidence alone.
- [ ] Record learning effort and maintenance/drift burden; preserve existing route preview and avoid duplicate setup requirements.
- [ ] Recommend the smallest effective aid or defer/drop; no real mandate, credential use, dispatch, escalation, or live authorization is created by rehearsal.

## Validation

Proposed later: compare docs and a narrated static storyboard, then ask prediction questions on different examples. Recurring errors corrected without false recovery/authority certainty support an optional aid.
